text: The sighting of these unidentified objects, or UFOs as they have come to be known,
has not been confined to our time, but has occurred throughout past ages as well.
The reports have come from all kinds of people.
Interspersed among those from obvious crafts have been sightings made by scientists,
by experienced pilots, radar operators, and others who knew what they were looking at.
One of the most exhaustive attempts to find it has been the American Air Force's Project Blue Book, covering all the available data surrounding 1,593 UFO reports.
Most of these, upon being tracked down, were found to have a natural and logical explanation.

Ice particles in the atmosphere reflecting diffused light, weather balloons, high flying aircraft, simple reflections from inversion air masses, and even the bellies of birds seen from a certain angle, distance, and light are only a few of the many natural phenomena that had been taken as flying saucers.
But what of the 27% of sightings by competent observers which Project Blue Book could not explain?
Is there additional information we have not yet learned that will show them up as perfectly natural phenomena?
Or would additional information explain them as something we now, in our present horizons of science, cannot even comprehend?
